name: headless-duckapi
description: Self-hosted Telegram AI bot on the duck.ai protocol — GPT/Claude/Mistral, streaming answers, /img, photo vision, Mini App. Also ships an OpenAI-compatible HTTP API (api.js) that needs no Telegram token. VPS port of a Telegram Serverless bot.

scripts.test: node test/orm.test.mjs && node test/http.test.mjs && node test/api.test.mjs
